LineComment.Text: =============================================================================== BLOCK / PURPOSE =============================================================================== This code builds a MES diagnostics snapshot (#Diag) from PLC<->MES handshake DBs. It: - Mirrors key signals into #Diag.Header / #Diag.LastError / #Diag.Special / #Diag.Station[i] - Measures heartbeat "age" and timeout for MES and PLC heartbeats - Tracks per-station handshake counters (OK / NG / Done / Timeout) with edge detection - Latches "UnexpectedDone" if Done arrives without active request - Implements RESET to clear all counters/flags in #Diag =============================================================================== ASSUMPTIONS / NOTES =============================================================================== - #_tHbMes, #_tHbPlc, #_tStove and #_tCi[], #_tCo[] are IEC TON timers - #HeartbeatTimeout_MES / _PLC, #CheckInTimeout, #CheckOutTimeout, #StoveCheckInTimeout are TIME - Indexing: stations are 1..8 - "ChickIn" naming in tags is preserved as-is (typo likely in original DB) ===============================================================================
